tool_calls.input:
const cmds = [
  ["semantic", `env PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -B -c '
import json, subprocess
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
manifest=load_manifest()
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
base_bytes=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:tome-orcs.lua"], cwd=manifest.root)
base=loader.load_bytes(base_bytes, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").records
cur=loader.load_path(manifest.root/"tome-orcs.lua", logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").records
assert len(base)==len(cur), (len(base),len(cur))
def stable(r): return {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k not in {"line","target","logical_path"}}
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(base,cur)):
    assert stable(a)==stable(b), (i, stable(a), stable(b))
changed=[(i,a,b) for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(base,cur)) if a.get("target")!=b.get("target")]
expected=json.load(open(manifest.root/".ai/task/repair-w42-20260927/BASELINE-records.json",encoding="utf-8"))["tome-orcs.lua"]
def ident(r): return tuple((k,json.dumps(r.get(k),ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)) for k in ("function_name","kind","section","source","source_tag","args_order","special"))
base_by_id={ident(r):r for r in base}
cur_by_id={ident(r):r for r in cur}
assert len(expected)==23
assert all(ident(e) in base_by_id and ident(e) in cur_by_id for e in expected)
assert all(base_by_id[ident(e)].get("target")==e.get("target") for e in expected)
assert {ident(a) for _,a,_ in changed}=={ident(e) for e in expected}
assert len(changed)==23
print("LuaJIT semantic load: PASS")
print("baseline: HEAD")
print("records:",len(cur))
print("target_changes:",len(changed))
print("non_target_fields_unchanged: true")
'`],
  ["lint", "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict"],
  ["diffcheck", "git diff --check"]
];
const rs = await Promise.all(cmds.map(async ([name,cmd]) => [name, await tools.exec_command({cmd,workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:12000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"允许我绕过损坏的 sandbox 隔离运行本次 FIX 要求的 LuaJIT、strict lint 与 diff 验证吗？"})]));
for (const [name,r] of rs) { text(`## ${name}\n${r.output}\nexit_code=${r.exit_code ?? "running"}${r.session_id ? `\nsession_id=${r.session_id}` : ""}`); }
